page.overview:
What is Batman?

Batman is a theme introduced in 2006 and discontinued in 2008. It was re-introduced in 2012 as part of the new DC Super Heroes theme.

Based largely on Batman: The Animated Series as well as Batman: Hush, some sets in the LEGO Batman theme included elements from other Batman universes, such as the Tumbler from the Christopher Nolan films (in original action scenes). Apart from 7784 The Batmobile Ultimate Collectors' Edition and 7885 Robin's Scuba Jet: Attack of The Penguin, every set pitted Batman against one or more of the many insane or eccentric villains that populate Gotham City. Some sets and minifigure appearances are based off LEGO Batman: The Videogame.
